title: Beyond Human Annotation: Recent Advances in Data Generation Methods for Document Intelligence

bias_targets.methodology: The survey reviews methodologies that evaluate if multimodal document intelligence models over-rely on language priors rather than visual evidence. This includes testing models on hybrid datasets with syntactically plausible but semantically incorrect pseudo-elements (e.g., fake formulas) and measuring modality redundancy to see if models can answer visual questions without actually referencing the image.
